headline: IEA Says Oil Shock From Iran War May Accelerate Alternative Energy Adoption
summary: An International Energy Agency analysis found that the oil shock resulting from the war in Iran could accelerate the global adoption of alternative power sources.
why: The International Energy Agency is an intergovernmental organization that provides policy recommendations, analysis, and data on global energy markets.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: The IEA analysis evaluates the global oil shock and its long-term impact on energy consumption.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
